title: The per-chain max capital (ETH_MAX_CAPITAL and the others, documented as "Max ETH deployment") is never enforced as a cap: it only scales the daily-loss threshold

evidence.note: the only use of maxCapitalNative: lossThreshold = -(maxCapital * dailyLossPct / 100)
per-chain deployed capital is computed (exposureByChain) but only returned for display (getPortfolioExposure)
ETH_MAX_CAPITAL=1.0 # Max ETH deployment (default: 1.0); the same wording for BSC/Base/Arbitrum at :22, :28, :34
consumers: riskManager.ts:96 (daily-loss scale), api/routes/chains.ts:84 (display), bot.ts:909 and :1248 (passed to canSnipe); no comparison of deployed capital with it

sibling_sites_checked: Every maxCapital read listed in evidence; preflight wallet floor uses snipeAmount x MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS + gasBuffer, not maxCapital (preflight.ts:200-202).
severity_rationale: S2: an operator who lowers ETH_MAX_CAPITAL to limit what the bot deploys on a chain gets no such limit; deployment stays bounded by MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS x snipe amount, MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE and the wallet balance, so the effect is bounded. At the defaults (10 x 0.01 ETH = 0.1 ETH < 1.0) the count binds first.
recommendation: Either enforce deployed-per-chain <= maxCapital in canSnipe or rename the setting to what it does (daily-loss base). Card DB-01. Phase 24.
